subject: llm-gateway deployment
content: llm-gateway runs as a systemd user service on the HP EliteDesk and listens on 127.0.0.1:8080.

subject: llm-gateway ops listener
content: The gateway's ops listener on 127.0.0.1:9090 serves /metrics and the admin endpoints; it is never exposed to the LAN.

subject: gateway provider
content: Decided to route all chat traffic through Groq first because it has the lowest time to first token.

subject: canary probe
content: A systemd timer sends one real request to each Groq model every five minutes as the canary tenant.

subject: canary budget
content: The canary tenant is capped at ten cents per day and actually spends about two cents.

subject: monitoring stack
content: Prometheus scrapes the gateway every fifteen seconds and keeps ninety days of history; Grafana shows the llm-gateway dashboard on localhost:3000.

subject: memory outside gateway
content: Conversation memory stays in persistence-memory, never inside llm-gateway, so the gateway keeps its promise of storing no prompts or answers.

subject: groq rate limits
content: Groq's free tier allowed roughly thirty requests per minute on gpt-oss-120b when we last checked.

subject: grafana password
content: Change the Grafana admin password from the default before opening the dashboard to the LAN.

subject: jarvis tenant
content: Jarvis has its own gateway tenant with a five dollar daily budget and no admin scope.

subject: answer style
content: Jon prefers short, direct answers with the command to run first and the explanation after.

subject: editor
content: Jon edits config files with nano, not vim.

subject: home network
content: The EliteDesk gets 192.168.1.102 from the router over Wi-Fi; the router itself is 192.168.1.1.

subject: dhcp reservation
content: Reserve 192.168.1.102 for the EliteDesk in the router's DHCP settings so its address stops changing.

subject: embedding models
content: bge-small and all-MiniLM-L6 both run on CPU in under 20 ms per sentence and are candidates for EMR semantic recall.

subject: persistence-memory storage
content: persistence-memory keeps the continuity ledger as a JSON file under ~/.local/share/persistence-memory and serves it on 127.0.0.1:8001.

subject: python tooling
content: Use uv to create Python virtual environments on the EliteDesk because the system Python lacks the venv module.

subject: rust toolchain
content: Rust is installed through rustup; the gateway needs at least Rust 1.88 and the box has 1.99.

subject: sqlite flaky tests
content: A few SQLite ledger tests in llm-gateway fail on a cold first run on this four-core machine and pass on rerun.

subject: ledger backend
content: The gateway uses the SQLite ledger on this box; Postgres is only needed when several replicas share one budget.

subject: merge style
content: Jon merges pull requests with a merge commit, not squash or rebase.

subject: github account
content: Jon's GitHub account is warheart1984-ctrl and commits use its noreply address.

subject: gateway framing
content: The gateway's normalized framing re-emits provider tokens under a frozen v1 SSE contract; passthrough relays vendor bytes verbatim.

subject: gateway budget units
content: Budgets are counted in nano-USD: one dollar is one billion nano-USD.

subject: local inference
content: Running Llama 3.1 8B locally would need a GPU with at least 8 GB of VRAM; the EliteDesk has none.

subject: tls
content: The gateway speaks plain HTTP only; anything beyond the home LAN must go through a reverse proxy that adds TLS.

subject: notifications
content: Jon wants alerts only for real breakage, not for every refused request.

subject: wolf cog os
content: Wolf CoG OS is Jon's governed cognitive operating system project with an invariant runtime and a provenance ledger.

subject: jarvis-render
content: jarvis-render is the Python chat bot front end for Jarvis.

subject: emr pipeline
content: EMR excites long-term memories into a short-term working set and consolidates them back to the ledger as draft summaries.

subject: backup
content: Nightly backups of the home directory go to the 2 TB USB drive mounted at /mnt/backup.

subject: coffee
content: Jon drinks black coffee and no sugar.

subject: birthday
content: Jon's brother's birthday is on the 14th of March.

subject: renew domain
content: Renew the mandala-render domain before it expires at the end of the year.

subject: machine specs
content: The HP EliteDesk 800 G2 has four CPU cores, 16 GB of RAM and a 228 GB SSD.

subject: os
content: The EliteDesk runs Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (noble).

subject: memory tenant
content: persistence-memory calls the gateway as the memory tenant, capped at two dollars a day.

subject: emr abstention
content: EMR abstains when the best memory's evidence score is below 0.05, which is why long questions sometimes recall nothing.

subject: open gateway to lan
content: Switch the gateway bind address to 0.0.0.0 and check ufw so other devices on the LAN can reach port 8080.

subject: gateway models
content: The gateway serves two Groq models: gpt-oss-120b and the cheaper gpt-oss-20b.

subject: gateway latency
content: Time to first token through the gateway to Groq is usually between 200 and 400 milliseconds.

subject: hot reload
content: Tenant and model changes are made by editing the YAML files; the gateway hot-reloads them within five seconds, no restart needed.

subject: secrets location
content: The Groq API key lives in ~/.config/llm-gateway/gateway.env with mode 600.

subject: greptile
content: The Greptile review bot's trial ended, so it no longer reviews pull requests.

subject: bm25
content: BM25 weights rare terms higher and normalizes for document length, which plain word overlap does not.

subject: ollama
content: Ollama is not installed on the EliteDesk.

subject: units
content: Jon prefers metric units and the 24-hour clock.

subject: timezone
content: Jon is in the US Eastern time zone.

subject: ci policy
content: Pull requests only merge after every CI check is green.

subject: wifi adapter
content: The EliteDesk connects through a USB Wi-Fi adapter because it has no built-in wireless card.

subject: histograms
content: Add latency histograms to the gateway so the dashboard can show p95 instead of only averages.

subject: decision record
content: Every refusal and failure a known caller receives is kept in the gateway's decision record, readable from /v1/admin/decisions.

subject: language
content: Jon prefers Python for glue scripts and Rust for long-running services.

subject: disk usage
content: About 12 GB of the SSD is used and roughly 205 GB is free.

subject: openai compatibility
content: Adding /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models to the gateway would let any OpenAI-style client use it without an adapter.

subject: gateway restarts
content: Restart the gateway with systemctl --user restart llm-gateway and read its logs with journalctl --user -u llm-gateway.

subject: rollback
content: The previous gateway binary is kept as llm-gateway.prev in ~/.local/bin for a one-command rollback.

content: Jon has a dog named Bruno.

content: Jon drives a 2015 Ford F-150.

content: Jon listens to lo-fi while coding.

content: The home router is a Netgear Nighthawk R7000.

subject: no port forwarding
content: Never forward router ports to the gateway; remote access must go through a VPN instead.

subject: vector store

subject: mandala rendering

subject: printer
content: The office printer is a Brother HL-L2350DW on 192.168.1.50.

content: The gateway listens on port 8080.
